questions.prompt: At a kopitiam, what do you get when you order kopi o?

source.note: Kopi o is black coffee with sugar; kopi has condensed milk and kopi c evaporated milk. Check: National Library Board Infopedia, 'Kopitiam'.

questions.prompt: Kaya is a spread made with coconut and eggs.

source.note: Kaya is made from coconut milk, eggs and sugar, often with pandan. Check: National Library Board Infopedia, 'Kaya'.

questions.prompt: Which spice gives curry powder its yellow colour?

source.note: Turmeric's pigment curcumin is bright yellow. Check: Britannica, 'turmeric'.

questions.prompt: Saffron comes from which part of the crocus flower?

source.note: Saffron is the dried stigmas of Crocus sativus. Check: Britannica, 'saffron'.
